en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance and minaret of a historic mosque. The tall square minaret with decorative arches rises above a large arched doorway framed by intricate ornamentation. In the foreground, several robed figures stand and converse near a donkey on an unpaved street in front of the mosque. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a mosque in Meknes.
